description: First floor rear extension with creation of second floor, additional windows and roof lights, ancillary to the main use.
decision_conditions: The development hereby permitted must be begun not later than the end of three years from the date of this permission. Reason: To comply with the provisions of S.51 of the Planning & Compulsory Purchase Act 2004.

The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans:26_1070_10026_1070_10126_1070_10226_1070_10326_1070_10426_1070_10526_1070_10626_1070_10726_1070_10826_1070_10926_1070_11026_1070_11126_1070_11226_1070_11326_1070_114Planning statementDesign and Access statement Reason: For the avoidance of doubt and in the interests of proper planning.

Prior to commencement of above ground construction, external materials specification, samples and detailed drawings (at 1:20 and 1:5) must be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority including: zinc cladding; window and door openings and installations including frame, panels, window bars; all roof junctions; all interfaces between new and existing; and plant enclosures.The development shall be implemented in accordance with the approved details and maintained as such thereafter. Reason: To ensure that the appearance of the development respects the appearance, existing materials and built and natural features of the surrounding area.

The development shall not commence until details of source control SuDS has been submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. Source control SuDS measures include green roofs, rain gardens and permeable paving. The details must include plans, specifications and maintenance information. The development shall be implemented in accordance with the approved details and shall be retained and maintained thereafter.Reason: To ensure the sustainable management of water, minimise flood risk, minimise discharge of surface water outside of the curtilage of the property and ensure that the drainage system will remain functional throughout the lifetime of the development in accordance with Policy CP28 of the Core Strategy, DMD Policy 61, and Policies SI12 & SI13 of the London Plan and the NPPF and to maximise opportunities for sustainable development, improve water quality, biodiversity, local amenity and recreation value.

The development hereby permitted shall not be occupied until waste storage and recycling facilities to satisfy the future number of occupiers on site have been provided within the development.  Such facilities to be retained permanently thereafter.Reason: In order to facilitate efficient, safe and clean removal of commercial refuse, the location and accessibility of refuse storage plus to maintain safety on the Highway.

Prior to commencement of above ground construction, a sustainable technology strategy must be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The strategy shall include:- Details of all proposed renewable and low-carbon technologies;- Detailed design, specification and performance information;- Details of the siting, installation, mounting and fixing arrangements for photovoltaic (PV) panels and air source heat pumps (ASHPs);- - Details of any screening, enclosure, attenuation and mitigation measures required to minimise visual and noise impacts;- Details demonstrating that the technologies have been designed to minimise visibility from surrounding streets and public viewpoints;- A scheme for the ongoing inspection, maintenance, repair and replacement of the equipment to ensure its continued operation throughout its lifetime.The approved measures shall be installed in accordance with the approved details prior to first occupation of the development and shall be retained and maintained thereafter.Reason: To ensure the sustainable energy infrastructure is appropriately designed and safeguards the character and appearance of the area and neighbouring residential amenity.

Prior to occupation of the development, details of the siting, number and design of secure/covered cycle parking spaces shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The approved details shall thereafter be installed and permanently retained for cycle parking.Reason: To ensure the provision of cycle parking spaces in line with the Council's adopted standards.

Prior to the occupation of the development, a Fire Statement, which is an independent fire strategy produced by a third party, suitably qualified assessor, shall be submitted to the Local Planning Authority and approved in writing in consultation with the London Fire Commissioner. The approved measures shall be implemented on site prior to the occupation of the development and shall be permanently maintained.Reason: In the interests of the safety of future occupiers.

The proposed office space hereby approved shall only be used as ancillary offices and shall not be used for any other purpose, unless otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority. Reason: To safeguard the interests of residential amenity, highway safety, servicing arrangements and to prevent a use that would be unacceptable in this location.
